messages.subject: about binwith or breaks for epicurve
parts:
when we drawing epicurve, the best binwidth is 1/3 to 1/8 of
incubation period,

ggplot work well when the x axis are date ,,
but food poisoning's incubation tend to be several hours, i cant
control the binwidth when the we have hours in x axis.

please tell me how to control binwidth , 1 hour, 2 hours....

thanks

data and code are here:


#epicurve, generate data like this
mydf <-data.frame(
mytime=as.POSIXct(seq(Sys.time(),len=100,by="1 hour")
[sample(100,50)])
)

#my breaks
breaks=as.POSIXct(seq(mydf$mytime[1],len=10,by="12 hours"))

qplot(mytime,data=mydf,geom="histogram",breaks=breaks)

did not work!!
